aboveboard: Above the board: hands visible over the table, no cheating. An aboveboard deal.
Aboveboard: nothing hidden under the table.
amok: Malay amuk: a frenzy. Run amok = rampage.
The bull ran amok in the shop.
animosity: Animus: spirit/anger. Open animosity between two families.
apex: Apex: the tip. Apex predator, apex of the triangle.
Apex = peak: at the top of the pyramid.
avarice: Avidus: greedy. Avarice drives the miser.
badger: Badger baiting: dogs pester it. Badger the boss for a raise.
beatific: Beatus: blessed. A beatific smile like a saint in glory.
becoming: Becoming: it suits you. A becoming hat.
Becoming ≠ turning into: here it means flattering.
bellicose: Bellum: war. A bellicose speech calls for battle.
cadaverous: Cadaver: corpse. Cadaverous face: hollow and pale.
cardinal: Cardo: hinge. Cardinal rules are the hinges.
catalyst: Catalysis: speeds up reactions. The scandal was a catalyst for reform.
Catalyst: the spark that makes it happen.
chauvinist: Chauvin: naïve veteran. A chauvinist thinks his group is the best.
check: Check (chess): stop the king. Check inflation: restrain it.
checkered: Checkerboard: black and white squares. A checkered past: good and bad.
cogent: Cogere: to drive together. A cogent argument forces agreement.
contrite: Contritus: crushed. A contrite child says sorry.
corroborate: Cor + roborare: strengthen. Corroborate the story with evidence.
desecrate: De + sacrare: unsacred. Desecrate a grave.
disparate: Dis + par: not equal. Disparate groups with nothing in common.
errant: Errare: wander. A knight errant roams.
exhort: Ex + hortari: urge. The coach exhorted the team.
Exhort: a rousing speech to act.
extenuating: Extenuare: make thin. Extenuating circumstances reduce blame.
Extenuating: the reasons that soften the verdict.
ferret: Ferret hunts rabbits in burrows. Ferret out the truth.
Ferreting through files for the clue.
fleece: Fleece: sheep’s wool, sheared. Fleece the tourists: charge too much.
flush: Flush with cash: wealthy; flush with the wall: level.
Flush: a cheque that just landed.
heyday: Heyday: hey! the best days. The heyday of jazz.
hodgepodge: Hochepot: stew. A hodgepodge of styles.
Hodgepodge: a jumble in the attic.
immaterial: Im + material: doesn’t matter. Irrelevant to the case.
imponderable: Can’t be pondered/weighed. The imponderables of the market.
junta: Junta: junction. A military junta rules after the coup.
lassitude: Lassus: tired. Lassitude after the exam.
melee: Mêlée: scrum. A melee at the sale.
misanthrope: Misein + anthropos: hater of people. Molière’s Alceste.
moment: Moment: importance. A matter of great moment.
paucity: Paucus: few. A paucity of evidence.
pittance: Pietas: pity: a charity dole. Paid a pittance.
preemptive: Pre + emere: buy first. A preemptive strike.
Preemptive: act before the other does.
raft: Raft: a large collection. A raft of reforms.
replete: Re + plere: fill. Replete with detail.
start: Start: jump. She started at the noise.
stem: Stem the flow: dam it. Stem the bleeding.
vicarious: Vicarius: substitute. Vicarious thrill reading adventures.
virago: Vir: man: a mannish loud woman. A virago shouted at the waiter.
wax: Wax: grow. The moon waxes. Wax lyrical.
Wax and wane: grow and shrink.
